title: Breakwater Cove Marina
specs: Deepest open water marina in Monterey with minimum 6' depth inside marina and 12' at fuel dock at zero tide
Shared docks with abundant wildlife such as sea otters, sea lions, and diverse sea and shore birds
Proof of insurance, registration or documentation, residency, and inspection for length and condition required for permanent slips
includes: Water, power, Wi-Fi, fuel dock, oil, bilge and head pump outs, dockside repair, chandlery, restrooms, hot showers, laundry room
blurb: Breakwater Cove Marina is a deep-water marina with 100 slips for vessels up to 200 feet. It offers amenities including water, power, Wi-Fi, fuel dock, pump outs, dockside repair, chandlery, restrooms, hot showers, and laundry. The marina is environmentally friendly and shares docks with local wildlife.
extraNote: Cancel guest slip by 3pm local time 24 hours prior or pay 1 night rental; may change for holidays and events · First month’s rent & security deposit required for permanent slips; refundable key & parking permit deposits of $50 and $100 each · All vessels must check in by radio or call before docking or fueling; unauthorized tie-ups not permitted
